content: Rohan Ahuja discusses his auto policy expiration with insurance agent Ramesh Tiwari and inquires about the policy reinstatement process. Ramesh explains that reinstatement requires paying the back premium along with a potential small lapse fee. Rohan finds the process manageable and requests a quote for the outstanding premium and lapse fee.

action_items: Provide a quote for the back premium and lapse fee to the customer
